decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: All query methods return iterators/references into the shared vbank/obank trees; no copies.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: Loc iterators walk the loc tree (space,offset,size,flags) order; def iterators walk the def tree (flags,def-order); op iterators walk optree SeqNum order then deadlist.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: uniq counters are per-bank monotonic; clean_up_index is a single Funcdata field (cc:90 reset).
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: VarnodeLocSet/VarnodeDefSet comparators (varnode.cc:41-66): loc by space/offset/size then flags; def by input|written flags then create-index; SeqNum by addr then uniq (address.hh:150-157).
